steps.text: The old stair stands unsealed, its gate ground open now that the floor is clear.
Aldric:  I told myself I was done with all this. Songs, heroes, roads that only go up.
Aldric:  But you cleared Emberfall, and the sky just proved there is more of it. You should not climb that alone.
Aldric:  So I am coming with you. Do not make me regret it, outsider.
He does not say how he knows the way. Not yet.
You set your foot on the first step beyond Emberfall.
